<thought>To determine the number of methyl (CH₃) groups, I will obtain the ¹H NMR spectrum of the sample. The spectrum will show peaks corresponding to methyl protons, typically around 0.8–1.2 ppm, and the integration values will indicate how many equivalent CH₃ groups are present. By analyzing the methyl region and the total integration, I can count the distinct methyl groups in the molecule.</thought>
